scope: Official import exception cleanup and interruption after case publication

findings.before: Case published then writer raised; cleanup deleted the referenced evidence.
findings.after: Cleanup requires original case bytes and owned destination inode; published or uncertain state preserves evidence.

findings.before: Case imported without completion event could pass status and proceed to finalize.
findings.after: load_workspace rejects incomplete_import; state-limit preflight prevents known event exhaustion before evidence writes.

validation.red_regressions: Old after-case fixture deleted evidence; old event-failure fixture did not reject status.
validation.real_cli: Kill import immediately after case.json publication; evidence remains, status/finalize exit4 incomplete_import, directory bytes unchanged, no receipt created.
fault_injection: before-case failure rolls back owned evidence
after-case and event failure preserve evidence and block use

independent_review.additional_probes: Different destination inode preserved; unreadable case preserves evidence; exact event-limit blocks without mutation. Reviewer-reported isolated temporary fixtures.

limits: No in-place automatic repair: preserve failed workspace and create a new run.
Lifecycle remains PARTIAL: journal/transaction recovery, pre-case kill orphans, other interruption windows, initialization competition remain open.
Source-ID event presence is not proof of event authenticity or full event-to-metadata reconciliation.
No Windows, network filesystem or power-loss durability acceptance.
No live provider, app, commit, push or release.
